banks.name: Allied Bank
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Pay Bills
Select KuickPay as Category and then Select relevant biller name. In case the biller is listed with KuickPay but not showing in myABL, select others as biller name.
Enter Consumer ID and click Validate
Confirm details and Pay
mobileBanking: Login to myABL Mobile App
Select Pay Bills
Select KuickPay as Category and then Select relevant biller name. In case the biller is listed with KuickPay but not showing in myABL, select others as biller name.
Enter Consumer ID and click Validate
Confirm details and Pay

banks.name: Al Baraka Bank
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Payments/Bill Payments
Select Kuickpay
Enter Consumer Number and fetch details
Confirm details and click Pay Now to Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Payment/Bill Payments
Select Kuickpay
Enter Consumer Number and fetch details
Confirm details and click Pay Now to Pay

banks.name: Askari Bank
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Payments and then Select Other Payments
Select E-Commerce as Billing Type and then Select Kuick Pay as company
Enter Order No and click Proceed
Confirm details and Select Account or Credit Card as Payment Mode
Generate and enter Financial Pin
Click Proceed to pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Bill Payments and then Select Account from PAY FROM option
Select E-Commerce as Company Type and then Select Kuick Pay as Bill Company
Enter or Select Consumer Number and click Next
Confirm details and click Next
Generate and enter Financial Pin
Click Submit to pay

banks.name: Bank AL Habib
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Bill Payment
Select Register Biller and then Select Add New Biller
Select Kuickpay as Biller Group and then Select Kuickpay as Biller
Enter Consumer Number and click Submit to confirm details
Enter Financial Pin to complete Biller Registration
Select Pay Bill
Select Kuickpay - Relevant Bill Nick Name from Registered Billers
Confirm details and Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Bill Payment
Select Register Biller and then Select Add New Biller
Select Kuickpay as Biller Group and then Select Kuickpay as Biller
Enter Consumer Number and click Submit to confirm details
Enter Financial Pin to complete Biller Registration
Select Pay Bill
Select Kuickpay - Relevant Bill Nick Name from Registered Billers
Confirm details and Pay
atm: Visit Bank AL Habib ATM and insert your Bank AL Habib ATM Card
Select Bill Payment
Select Kuickpay as Biller
Enter Consumer Number and click Submit
Confirm details and Pay

banks.name: Bank Alfalah
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Services and then Select Payments
Select Others and then Select Kuickpay as Company
Select Other as Beneficiary then Enter Consumer Number and click Fetch Details
Confirm details and Select Account or Credit Card
Click Pay Now to Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Alfa Mobile Banking App
Expend (V) (down arrow) and select payments
Enter Consumer Number as Other and click Fetch Title
Confirm details and click Pay Now
Select Account, Credit Card or Wallet
Click Pay Now to Pay
atm: Visit Bank Alfalah ATM and insert your Bank Alfalah ATM Card
Select Bill Payment
Select Kuickpay as Biller in Others or Education
Enter Consumer Number and click Submit
Confirm details and Pay

banks.name: BankIslami
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Bill Payments and then Select Bills / Payments Management
Click Add Bill / Payments
Select Others as Bill / Payment Category and then Select Kuickpay as Bill / Payment Company
Enter Consumer Number and then Enter Referance Name (for your own memorization). Click Next to confirm details
Enter OTP and click Confirm to complete Bill Registration
Select Pay Bills / Make Payments under Bill Payments
Select Others as Bill / Payment Category and then Select Kuickpay as Bill / Payment Company
Select Account and then Select Kuickpay - Referance Name from Beneficiary
Click Next to Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Payments and then Select Bills
Click (+) to Add Bill
Select Others as Bill Type and then Select Kuickpay as Company Type
Enter Consumer Number and click Confirm
Enter Referance Name (for your own memorization) and then Enter OTP. Click Confirm
Select Kuickpay - Relevant Bill Nick Name from Billing List
Confirm details and Pay
atm: Visit BankIslami ATM and insert your BankIslami ATM Card
Select Bill Payment
Select Others and then Select Kuickpay
Select Unregistered if paying for a new bill or Select Registered if the bill is previously registered, added or paid
Enter Consumer Number and click Continue
Confirm details and Pay

banks.name: Bank of Khyber (BOK)
mobileBanking: Login to your BOK Mobile Banking App and select Bill Payments
Select on Add+
Select Others
Select KUICKPAY
Enter Consumer Number and click Next
Verify Details and Enter OTP
Bill Added Successfully

banks.name: Bank of Punjab (BOP)
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Bill Payments
Click Add Bill Payee
Select Others as Payment Type, Select Others as Category, and then Select kuickpay as Company
Enter Consumer Number and click Next
Confirm details and click Confirm
Click OK to complete Add Bill Payee process
Click on Bill Payment while staying on Bill Payments option
Select your newly added Bill under Bill Payees
Select Account and click Next
Confirm details and click Confirm to Pay
atm: Visit BOP ATM and insert your BOP ATM Card
Select Bill Payment
Select Others and then Select Kuickpay
Enter Consumer Number
Confirm details and Pay

banks.name: Dubai Islamic Bank (DIB)
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Bill Payment
Select Utility as Service Type, Select KPay as Service
Select One Time Payment if paying for a new bill or Select Bill from Registered Bill if the bill is previously registered, added or paid
Enter (for One Time Payment) or Select (for Bill from Registered Bill) Consumer Number and click Get Bill
Confirm details and Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Bill Payment
Select Utility as Service Type, Select KPay as Service
Select One Time Payment if paying for a new bill or Select Bill from Registered Bill if the bill is previously registered, added or paid
Enter (for One Time Payment) or Select (for Bill from Registered Bill) Consumer Number and click Get Bill
Confirm details and Pay

banks.name: Digitt+
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Payment
Select Category ‘Kuickpay’, & company ‘Kuickpay’
Enter Kuickpay id & press ‘Submit’
Verify the payment details & click on ‘Pay Now’
Enter 5 Digit Pin, after pin verification
Payment will be done successfully

Enter Consumer Number and click Next

banks.name: HabibMetro Bank (HMB)

Select Educational Fee as Utility Type and then Select Kuick Pay as Utility Name
Enter Consumer Number and click Proceed

banks.name: HBL
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Pay and then Select Add New Option
Select KuickPay and then Select KuickPay
Enter Consumer Number and click Next
Confirm details and then click Next
Enter One Time Password and then enter Transaction Password
Click Pay

Select KuickPay under Payments
Click on (+) and then select KuickPay as Company
Enter Consumer Number and click Next

banks.name: JazzCash App
mobileApp: Login to your JazzCash Mobile App
Enter Consumer ID and fetch details
Enter MPIN and Proceed to pay

banks.name: JS Bank
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Bill Payment and then Select Bill Registration
Select Service Type as DIGITALPAYMETS and then Select Service as KUICKPAY
Enter Consumer Number and then enter Consumer Nick as per your convenience
Generate and Enter email/mobile Tokens and Click Register
Locate your newly Added Bill in the Registered Services list and Click on Pay Now
Review your transaction details, Enter your Financial PIN and Click Confirm to Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Pay and then Select Corporate Payments
Click on Add Payee then Select KUICKPAY as company
Enter Consumer Number and then enter Consumer Nick as per your convenience
Generate and Enter email/mobile Tokens and Click Register
Locate your newly Added Bill and proceed for Payment
Review your transaction details, if asked, Enter your Financial PIN and proceed to Pay

Select Digital Vouchers as Bill Type and then Select KuickPay as Company
Enter Consumer Number and then Enter Short Name as per your convenience
Click Next and Enter One Time Password

banks.name: MCB bank
internetBanking: Login to your Internet Banking
Select Bill Payment
Select Register Biller and then Click Add New Biller
Select Customer and then Select Innovarge(Kuick Pay) as Biller
Enter Consumer Number and then Enter Nick Name as per your convenience
Click Submit and then Click Confirm
Enter Transaction Pin and then Click Submit
Click OK to complete Biller Registration
Select Pay Bill
Select Customer and then Select your newly added KuickPay Bill as Biller, Select Account and then Click Submit
Verify details and then Click Confirm to Pay
mobileBanking: Login to your Mobile Banking App
Select Payments and then Select Utility Bill Payment
Select Add Beneficiary for new Bill or skip to step 9 for Payment of existing bill
Select Utility Bill Payment under Add Payment Beneficiary
Select KuickPay from the list
Enter Consumer Number and then Enter Beneficiary's Name as per your convenience. Click Submit
Confirm Details and then Click Submit
Enter OTP and then Click Submit to complete Add Payments Beneficiary process
Select Payments from Main Menu then Select your newly added KuickPay bill, Click Next
Verify details and Click Submit to Pay

Select Utility as Payee Type and then Select KuickPay as Payee Name
Enter Consumer Number and complete the Bill Registration process
